dedupe_keys.name: unido industrial statistics databases indstat via the uk data service

description: This is the UNIDO industrial statistics collection (INDSTAT) as distributed by the UK Data Service, giving manufacturing statistics by country and industry. The DataCite record for an earlier edition says it comprises INDSTAT2 at the 2-digit ISIC level for about 170 countries from 1963, and INDSTAT4 at the 3- and 4-digit level for recent years, with variables such as establishments, employment, wages, output and value added; the UK Data Service page now titles it UNIDO Industrial Statistics Databases, 1963-2018, with an online UKDS.Stat view. A companion UK Data Service study (4752) holds the UNIDO Industrial Demand-Supply Balance database. Title and ownership stay with UNIDO. Access is safeguarded: registration is required and the page says it is available only to those registered at UK higher or further education institutions, for education and research use, with no charge stated. Caveats: country and item coverage differ by country, and the UNIDO site itself could not be read from this environment. For simulation it gives industry-level output and employment to weight the economic exposure of manufacturing sectors by country. Related catalogue records include the BGS world mineral statistics and the NBER-CES manufacturing industry database.
